requirements: Reproduce the Kevin paper: a multi-turn RL training recipe (on top of QwQ-32B) for CUDA kernel generation on KernelBench, demonstrating improvements over the base model, single-turn RL baseline, and frontier models, along with the reported test-time scaling behaviors.
